initial_quality_observation.primary_defect: Responsive horizontal overflow at tablet/mobile-small widths prevented acceptance.
initial_quality_observation.commercial_effect: A customer-facing mobile build cannot be sold confidently while horizontal layout defects remain.

improvements_performed: Corrected invalid tablet shell width calculation and intrinsic grid sizing.
Added robust wrapping for long German service labels.
Measured exact 320px overflow offenders and changed the service signal strip to wrap on small screens.
Clipped only the residual root scroll artifact after no DOM element remained outside the viewport.

top_quality_gaps.impact: The synthetic run cannot honestly include real team/project photography, certifications, qualifications, reviews or verified contact/legal details. These are the largest remaining trust lever for a real customer launch.
The commercial logic is coherent and validated, but external writes/messages/events are deliberately blocked in this zero-cost safety run.
The custom visual system is strong, but real project photos or documented work examples would make the page feel more established and locally authentic once supplied by a real customer.

sellability.meaning: Confidently chargeable as a professionally designed customer system and private customer-ready preview, with real trust assets and production integration activation explicitly remaining onboarding/launch work rather than pretending they already exist.

provider_review.reason: No current output area shows a quality deficit large enough to justify replacing the existing native Web/Business/Automation path. Framer could be considered later for a visual-production workflow, but this run does not establish a material quality advantage that warrants switching providers.
